answer_text: Yes. OAP section 8 directs that car use be limited through underground car parks or parking within building envelopes, with pooled parking and 'l'accueil d'un nombre réduit de places de stationnement le long des voies' (c-01)[l'accueil d'un nombre réduit de places de stationnement le long des voies]. These measures appear as items under the heading 'privilégier les circulations douces' (c-02)[la limitation de l'utilisation de la voiture, avec la réalisation de parkings souterrains ou dans le gabarit des constructions].
discrepancy_note: The planner rationale describes the on-street parking limit as separate from the underground or shared-parking guidance. In the source, the on-street limit is one of two items in the same bullet as underground parking and pooled parking, so it is not a separate rule.
additional_context: The text is a directional orientation ('doit permettre'), not a numeric cap; no specific number of on-street spaces is given. The passage refers to the quartier as a whole rather than to the parcel's road specifically. The printed page is 34 and the PDF page is 35.
